name: frag-bridge
description: Bind a project to a local governed FRAG conversation and VS Code language models.

frag.hostInstallation.description: Installed Host directory. Empty uses the standard local v1.10.1 installation.

frag.modelConfigFile.description: Required explicit path to the dedicated Agents instance's User/chatLanguageModels.json. VS Code 1.140.0 Agents shares that instance's Default resources; named editor profiles are not used. No implicit fallback or key copying.
